text:
alex: heads up — after the 03:20 runtime hotpatch the latency dashboard lost the tail lines (p95/p99) for several services, only p50/p90 visible :grimacing:

maria: saw that too. spike alerts didn't fire because alerts are based on the p99 panel. opening a ticket with support now.

simon: tagging my query: the dash uses this promQL originally: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service))` — can someone check the raw metric?

jae: quick check: raw `request_duration_seconds_bucket` is being emitted, but label set changed — `service` got renamed to `svc` in the agent rollout. dash panels filter on `service=~\".*\"` so nothing matches.

alex: ahhh that would do it. did agent change go out in the same cutover as the hotpatch?

lisa: yes, the collector v2.1.3 deployment included the label rename. it was intentional (slim labels) but we forgot compatibility aliasing.

maria: opsbot created ticket RW-9876 for the customer-facing console regression and escalated to product. linking dash: https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency/latency-overview?org=redwood

opsbot: RW-9876 created by maria — priority P1. Affected panels: latency tails (p95/p99) and service-level percentile overlays.

simon: repro steps for eng to confirm: 1) query prom for `request_duration_seconds_bucket{svc=\"api\"}` 2) run the dashboard promQL but replace `service` with `svc` 3) observe p95/p99 return.

alex: tested on staging: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, svc))` brings tails back. so root cause = label rename in collector.

jae: plan: 1) short-term: update dashboards to accept both labels (service OR svc) and patch the hosted dashboards for the next 30m; 2) medium: ship compatibility exporter that copies `svc` -> `service` label for one week; 3) long-term: communicate label spec and avoid silent renames.

lisa: I'll cut the dashboard patch now. pushing a json change to grafana repo and will notify infra to roll out.

maria: customer comms: notifying affected customers and telling them it's limited to the console visualization, API latency metrics and alerts are unchanged if you use label `svc`.

alex: also adding a temporary alert that triggers if panels return no series for `histogram_quantile` queries so we catch future breakages automatically.

simon: leaving a note in the changelog and tagging the collector PR with RW-9876.

jae: thanks all. once dashboards are patched I'll validate on prod and close RW-9876. :thumbsup:
